import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def model(p,t,x,v):
    w=p[0]
    return -p[1]*x - p[2]*v - p[3]*x**3 + p[4]*np.cos(w*t)+p[5]*np.sin(w*t)+p[6]
